title: A Terminal for the Horizon Revisited
author: Mirabel Villalobos
blurb: Ines Halloran, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
